description: Public-procurement record of a Spanish company from the Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público (Ministerio de Hacienda CODICE feeds: hosted profiles and aggregated regional platforms with archives since 2012, minor contracts of the hosted profiles since 2018, daily updates): contracts WON matched by legal-person NIF (`attributions`: buyer with DIR3, subject, CPV, lot, closed-list result such as awarded or formalised, award date, amounts in EUR excl. and incl. tax as published, tenders received, SME flag) and notices ISSUED as a buyer (`avis_emis`, public entities with a NIF); minor contracts in their own lists (`contrats_mineurs` won, `contrats_mineurs_passes` as buyer), named in `blocs_absents` (collecte_en_cours) until first collected; newest first, capped at 100 per list, total and cut in `listes_bornees`; `attributions` and `contrats_mineurs` newest first by award date, else (missing or with a reserve) by the day of the file's latest version (mis_a_jour, Europe/Madrid). Never a natural-person winner (DNI, NIE or masked identifier; refused without charge) nor a consortium without its own NIF; a file cancelled by the source is no longer served as awarded. An aberrant award date is served as published with a closed-list `reserves[]` on its line, counted in `reserves_lignes`. Partial coverage: zero never means “never won a contract”; a NIF with no row, or a source placeholder NIF (`identifiant_bouche_trou`), answers 404 without charge. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

nif.description: Spanish legal-person NIF: one letter (A-D, F, G, N, P-S, U-W), seven digits and a check character, e.g. A28582013; DNI/NIE (natural persons) are refused, and an E, H, J NIF (entity without legal personality, owners' association, civil partnership) returns 404, not billed

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_spanish_company_public_procurement

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
